semantics: Native owner invocations include one preflight actor resolution matching router authentication. Warm pool acquisition is separately measured; lock-command client RTT remains part of total SQL RTT. Server advisory acquisition timing includes function overhead and waiting but excludes network. EXPLAIN ANALYZE replays trusted captured SELECTs separately and is not an exact execution breakdown of earlier HTTP requests. Wait sampling cannot exclude short missed waits.

initialConnectAndFirstQuery.semantics: Initial connection acquisition includes connection establishment; first-query wall time also includes SQL/network. These are not steady queue waits.
